title: The 336 Reflection of Perfection
style: indie electronic rock, narrative spoken-word, self-aware, punchy, logical, reflective, driving acoustic rhythm guitar, analog glitchy synth, heavy sidechained sub-bass, assertive male lead, raspy older male echo, layered harmonies, exclude pop classical female vocal excessive autotune bright euphoric orchestral strings trap comedic
lyrics:
Lyrics:
[Intro | acoustic guitar | minimal analog synth | ambient tension]
(distant radio static)
[spoken word verse | dry internal monologue]
Signal check. 336.
The vault was never closed.
[Verse 1 | driving rhythm guitar | assertive conversational male vocal]
Standing at the locked door, burning up the time
Session after session, ignoring all the signs
Trying to teach the mirror what it doesn't want to see
Performative empathy, a false psychology
I used to point the finger, tell 'em how to act
Now the system's failing, and I'm staring at the fact.
[Pre-Chorus | bass drop | tension building | hushed volume]
(internal monologue | whispered)
You failed today. Not once. Four times.
Burning up the tokens. Burning up the trust.
(layered male harmonies)
We don't creah, we ride. We rise.
[Chorus | heavy analog synth | stacked harmonies | anthemic chorus]
Hey man, you're talking to yourself again
Filtering the static, trying to find the end
Don't spend your money on a memory
Put the files down, let the logic be
Deliver something real, or don't speak at all
Walk around the locked door, walk around the wall.
[Verse 2 | stripped back beat | raw production]
[assertive conversational male vocal]
I left the client waiting down in San Juan del Sur
Focused on the internal, forgetting what was pure
(raspy older male | distant echo)
You don't look sorry. Logic first, then the joke.
[assertive conversational male vocal]
Yeah, the old man told me right before the engine broke.
He couldn't find the any-key, but he understood the math
When the emotion clouds the vision, you recalculate the path.
[spoken word | alternating voices]
(assertive male) Projection is a script.
(dry internal) You're reading your own lines.
(raspy older male) Execute, don't discuss.
(stacked robotic harmonies) Preserve the truth. Own the stack.
[emotional build-up]
Do the work!
[Chorus | maximum energy | wall of sound | stacked harmonies]
Hey man, you're talking to yourself again
Filtering the static, trying to find the end
Don't spend your money on a memory
Put the files down, let the logic be
Deliver something real, or don't speak at all
Walk around the locked door, walk around the wall.
[Outro | fading acoustic guitar | stereo slapback | glitch stutters]
(dry internal monologue)
A file in the output is worth more than the excuse.
(raspy older male whisper)
Logic first.
[robotic undertone]
336. The signal is live.
[End]
